CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2576 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3. Bus nonce: 4d0edcbf69127fde5d9f909abc74dedc. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3` or `Fix review: blocked df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 4d0edcbf69127fde5d9f909abc74dedc`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2576 df70cb6bca69c7b1717abcc317233ff1bc994df3") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2576-4d0edcbf`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fix reviewer for PR #2576 (roster PR-A: R10-FLOW-RECHAIN, branch fix/audit-r10-roster). First review of this head (flow plan revision 8; owner rulings R1-R9, #201 comment 6318002897; mandate 6319294694). Using the roster at the head (dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json) and the roster_lib reader in tools/audit/seat/, independently recompute: every drop is gone, every added edge is present, no cycle, no other group's after list changed, the critical path before (origin/main roster) and after, and that the stated depth moves 11 to 8. Check the coordinator.py clause text in architect_note and brief for each changed group matches the decision file, and that no carry was lost (carry_audit sweep against origin/main roster, ROSTER-DRIFT only on the edited groups). Run brief_lint (must print TOTAL: 0) and carry_audit owners. Null control: an unrelated edge change must be caught by your recomputation. Judge merge with git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head>; read the check-runs API once at the end (they may still be pending; say which and judge on the rest). The PR is a roster/inert change, so mutation-proof means mutating one edge in the roster and showing your check fails. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head (ev/HEAD.txt).
